stories.title: Meta releases open weights for Muse Spark Open
stories.summary: An 816B-parameter (42B active) multimodal model with a 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work; weights are on Hugging Face and it is served by Baseten, Fireworks AI, Groq, Modal, OpenRouter and others.
stories.why: A strong open-weight coding and agent model he can call through cheap API hosts for his own agent projects.

stories.title: MBZUAI releases Jais 3, open Arabic agent models
stories.summary: Six Apache 2.0 models from 0.9B to 375B parameters with a 512K-token context, trained to plan tasks, call tools and MCP servers and edit files while chatting in Arabic.
stories.why: Small open models (3.7B and 7B) that are tuned for tool calling are a useful template for running agents locally.

stories.title: Modal raises $750M Series D after passing $1B run rate
stories.summary: Modal says usage tripled in five months and it grew more than 15x year over year; the round was led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation, per its announcement and coverage.
stories.why: Serverless AI infrastructure is booming, and Modal's sandboxes are what many coding agents run on.

stories.title: Jio Platforms sets price band for India's biggest IPO
stories.summary: Reliance's digital arm priced its IPO at ₹1,065-1,119 a share, raising about ₹30,213 crore at the top end; it opens October 21 and closes October 23, all fresh issue.
stories.why: A record tech IPO in an emerging market, a signal for how investors value telecom-plus-digital platforms like Safaricom.

stories.title: Fragment raises $12M so AI agents can handle money safely
stories.summary: The New York startup's double-entry ledger API lets agents automate billing and accounting while blocking invalid transactions; FirstMark and BoxGroup co-led the Series A.
stories.why: Agents plus fintech ledgers is exactly the overlap of his Kwara work, and a niche that is hiring.

stories.title: African startups raised $2.49B in nine months as Q3 rebounded
stories.summary: 315 disclosed deals so far in 2026, up 7.8% year on year; Q3 alone brought $1.025 billion, and Kenya ranks fourth with $297 million.
stories.why: More late-stage African money means more local engineering hiring, including at Kenyan startups like ARC Ride and SunCulture.

stories.title: Big Tech races to hire forward deployed engineers
stories.summary: US FDE postings passed 7,300 in the first nine months of 2026, up from under 200 in 2023 (Lightcast); AWS committed $1 billion and Anthropic plans to train 10,000 FDEs by end-2027.
stories.why: Forward deployed engineering is one of his target roles, and demand for it is rising fast.

stories.title: AfDB and UNDP move AI 10 Billion plan toward delivery
stories.summary: The initiative aims to channel $1 billion a year for a decade into African AI and says it can contribute to 25 million new jobs by 2035, starting in 5 countries and reaching 20 by end-2027.
stories.why: Development money aimed at AI projects in Africa could create applied AI roles in Nairobi.

stories.title: Kenya's draft payments bill could slow fintech fundraising
stories.summary: The National Payment System Bill, 2026 would require CBK written approval for anyone acquiring 10% or more of a licensed payment firm, with no deadline for CBK to decide.
stories.why: Slower deal closings could squeeze hiring budgets at Kenyan fintechs he might apply to.

stories.title: Safaricom says AI stops 94% of attempted fraud
stories.summary: CEO Peter Ndegwa told Safaricom's cybersecurity summit in Nairobi that AI prevents 94% of attempted fraud in real time, as ICT CS William Kabogo warned of deepfake risks.
stories.why: Fraud-detection AI on mobile money is a live engineering area in Kenyan fintech.
